hunks.baseline: Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist. True to its name, its overwhelming heat transformed into blue-white flames and surged upward.
hunks.sol: The overwhelming heat of the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist lived up to its name, surging upward in blue-white flames.

hunks.baseline: The tremendous roar that erupted the next moment swallowed every other sound.
hunks.sol: A tremendous roar swallowed every other sound.

hunks.baseline: Layer after layer of powerful defensive Magic—and even the ceiling, made from exceptionally durable magical materials—collapsed and melted beneath the extreme heat.
hunks.sol: Layer after layer of powerful defensive Magic gave way. Even ceilings made of exceptionally durable magical materials collapsed and melted under the extreme heat.

hunks.baseline: Whenever one ceiling disappeared, another appeared, and then yet another ceiling blocked my path.
hunks.sol: Each time a ceiling vanished, another appeared to block my path.

hunks.baseline: But I surged upward as a pillar of fire, smashing, piercing, and melting everything that stood in my way.
hunks.sol: I rose like a pillar of fire, smashing through and melting everything in my way.

hunks.baseline: Boom. Crackle.
hunks.sol: Boom. Crack.

hunks.baseline: How high had I risen? How many ceilings had I destroyed?
hunks.sol: How high had I climbed? How many ceilings had I broken through?

hunks.baseline: At last, when my body came to a stop, beyond the wavering flames…
hunks.sol: When I finally came to a stop, beyond the wavering flames…

hunks.baseline: There were people waiting for me—no, enemies who had finished making every possible preparation.
hunks.sol: People were waiting for me—no, enemies, ready for my arrival.

hunks.baseline: As if they had been waiting for this moment alone, the enemies fired arrows, Magic, and everything else at once.
hunks.sol: As though they had been waiting for this exact moment, they unleashed arrows and Magic all at once.

hunks.baseline: And at the moment countless rays of light shot toward me, I muttered a command in my mind that no one could hear.
hunks.sol: As countless streaks of light hurtled toward me, I silently gave a command.

hunks.baseline: The cool sensation of the spear shaft disappeared from my grip. I gathered the flames that had not yet died down into both hands and thrust out my palms.
hunks.sol: The cool spear shaft vanished from my grip. I drew the lingering flames into both hands and thrust out my palms.

hunks.baseline: Flame Divine Palm at eight-tenths mastery. A fire dragon burst from both palms and writhed through the air.

hunks.baseline: Terrible heat swept through the wide corridor stretching out on either side. Magic, arrows, and even people were caught in it.
hunks.sol: At eight-tenths power, the Flame Divine Palm sent a fire dragon surging from my palms. It twisted through the wide corridor stretching to either side, sweeping up Magic, arrows, and people alike.

hunks.baseline: What remained where the flames subsided was screaming and foul stench. The smell of flesh roasting and cries of agony overflowed from every direction.
hunks.sol: When the flames died down, screams and a foul stench remained. The smell of cooking flesh hung over the corridor, and cries of pain rose from every direction.

hunks.baseline: If I had used my full strength, more than half of them would have burned to death without even managing to scream.
hunks.sol: If I had used my full strength, more than half of them would have burned to death without a scream.

hunks.baseline: I turned my head toward the voice.
hunks.sol: I turned toward the voice.

hunks.baseline: At the end of the corridor, a dozen or so healers stood with their mouths hanging open, staring at the scene before them.
hunks.sol: At the end of the corridor, a dozen or so healers stood with their mouths open, staring at the scene before them.

hunks.baseline: “What are you doing? Run your asses over here and save your comrades.”
hunks.sol: “What are you doing? Get your asses over here and save your comrades.”

hunks.baseline: “Mr. Jin Taekyung, why on earth are you…?”
hunks.sol: “Mr. Jin Taekyung, why on earth are you doing this?”

hunks.baseline: “Because there’s something I absolutely have to do. And because you people got in my way.”
hunks.sol: “Because there’s something I have to do. And you people got in my way.”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know what your circumstances are, but still… This is too much, isn’t it?”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know what happened, but still… Isn’t this going too far?”

hunks.baseline: When I met her eyes, filled with fear and anger, I felt like the worst bastard in the world. Maybe that was why a hollow laugh escaped me.
hunks.sol: Her eyes were full of fear and anger. Looking at her, I felt like the worst bastard in the world. Maybe that was why a hollow laugh escaped me.

hunks.baseline: The Ares Guild emblem sewn into their clothes irritated me, and their shameless behavior was absurd.
hunks.sol: The Ares Guild emblems sewn onto their clothes irritated me. So did the nerve of them.

hunks.baseline: That was precisely why I stopped instead of simply walking away.
hunks.sol: That was why I stopped instead of walking away.

hunks.baseline: “Too much? Fuck, you’re the ones who went too far.”
hunks.sol: “Too far? Fuck, you’re the ones who went too far.”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t think people who came swarming over to kill me over those words—Code Red—have any right to say that.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t think people who came swarming over to kill me at the words *Code Red* get to say that.”

hunks.baseline: “I said meeting one person would be enough. I even tried to avoid an unnecessary fight. But you were the ones who attacked first, and you’re the ones who went down.”
hunks.sol: “I said all I needed was to meet one person. I even tried to avoid a fight with people who had nothing to do with this. But you attacked first, and you’re the ones who went down.”

hunks.baseline: I understood. They had no direct connection to Kim Hwajong’s death. How could the hands and feet know what the head had planned?
hunks.sol: I understood that they had no direct connection to Kim Hwajong’s death. How could the hands and feet know what the head had planned?

hunks.baseline: But the fact that an order had been given did not erase what they had done. They had gathered at an order to kill one person.
hunks.sol: But receiving an order didn’t erase what they had done. They had assembled to kill a person because someone told them to.

hunks.baseline: “Why are you doing this? I don’t know what your circumstances are, but…”
hunks.sol: *Why are you doing this? I don’t know what happened, but…*

hunks.baseline: Above the low groans, a quiet voice slipped between my lips and echoed through the blackened corridor.
hunks.sol: My quiet voice carried over the low groans and echoed through the blackened corridor.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t spout bullshit. You should’ve thought about it before asking. Why did that bastard Jin Taekyung suddenly start acting like this? Why did a guy everyone praised for saving people and killing monsters come to our Guild and cause a scene, demanding that we bring out Go Jun? And why was an order given to kill him?”
hunks.sol: “Cut the bullshit. You should’ve thought before you asked. Why would Jin Taekyung suddenly do something like this? Why would a guy everyone praises for saving people and killing monsters storm our Guild and demand that we bring out Go Jun? And why did someone order you to kill him?”

hunks.baseline: To give them the conclusion first: I wasn’t.
I lacked any noble spirit of self-sacrifice. I cared about money. And rather than living for strangers I had never met, I wanted to live for my own people.
hunks.sol: I wasn’t one. I didn’t have some noble spirit of self-sacrifice. I cared about money, and I’d rather live for my own people than for strangers I’d never met.

hunks.baseline: But… at the same time, I thought I had lived without shame.
hunks.sol: But… I thought I’d lived without shame.

hunks.baseline: After gaining this power far beyond my station, I believed I had used it for other people whenever possible.
hunks.sol: Since gaining power far beyond anything I deserved, I believed I’d used it for other people whenever I could.

hunks.baseline: What kind of person was I? Was this choice right? I questioned myself again and again.
hunks.sol: I had always questioned myself—what kind of person I was, whether the choices I made were right.

hunks.baseline: “Then why? Why? Why?”
hunks.sol: “So why? Why? Why?”

hunks.baseline: I kept throwing out those empty questions. The vacant faces in my view disgusted and repulsed me.
hunks.sol: I kept asking, though I already knew the questions were empty. The blank faces before me made me sick.

hunks.baseline: “When you’re told to kill a person, why did you come here without even questioning the order?”
hunks.sol: “When you’re told to kill someone, why do you come here without even questioning the order?”

hunks.baseline: No one answered, but I already knew the answer myself.
hunks.sol: No one answered. I knew the answer anyway.

hunks.baseline: Because they were nothing more than fingernails—not even Go Jun’s hands and feet. Because they were dogs living off the food Go Jun and Ares Guild gave them.
hunks.sol: They weren’t even Go Jun’s hands and feet. They were his fingernails. Dogs living off the food Go Jun and Ares gave them.

hunks.baseline: They could gain more wealth and honor by carrying out their mission. That was why, just as they had always done, they had stood in my way.
hunks.sol: Do the job, and they could gain more wealth and status. That was why they had stood in my way, just as they always had.

hunks.baseline: “Do you even have any idea what that bastard Go Jun has done? What if the Monster Waves in Busan and Pyeongchang were artificially caused by him?”
hunks.sol: “Do you have any idea what that bastard Go Jun has done? What if he caused the Monster Waves in Busan and Pyeongchang himself?”

hunks.baseline: The moment I finished speaking, shouts erupted from every direction.
hunks.sol: Shouts broke out before I had even finished.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: Right. I knew they would react like this. That was why I had come all the way here.
hunks.sol: Right. I’d expected that. It was why I’d come all the way here.

hunks.baseline: Looking at their distrustful expressions, I let out a hearty laugh.
hunks.sol: I looked at their disbelieving faces and let out a laugh.

hunks.baseline: It was fascinating. They remained silent about why a man called a hero had invaded Ares Guild, yet when it came to other matters, they immediately denied everything.
hunks.sol: Funny. They had nothing to say about why a man they called a hero had stormed Ares Guild. But bring up Go Jun, and they rushed to deny it.

hunks.baseline: “What did the higher-ups promise you in exchange for taking me down? A lightning-fast promotion within the Guild? Enough wealth to feed several generations?”
hunks.sol: “What did your bosses promise you for taking me down? A fast track to the top of the Guild? Enough money to keep your families fed for generations?”

hunks.baseline: “Please, don’t give me bullshit about not having enough money to raise your kids or needing to support your widowed mother. You’re not starving right now.”
hunks.sol: “And please, spare me the bullshit about needing money to raise your kids or support your widowed mother. None of you are going hungry.”

hunks.baseline: Every person here had succeeded in life. Whether they had wanted it or not, they had awakened one day and displayed enough skill to enter Ares Guild.
hunks.sol: Everyone here had made it. Whether they’d wanted to or not, they’d Awakened one day and shown enough talent to join Ares Guild.

hunks.baseline: I had no intention of blaming them for the wealth and honor they had gained. I had once dreamed of that kind of life myself.
hunks.sol: I didn’t begrudge them the wealth or status that came with it. I’d once dreamed of having those things myself.

hunks.baseline: But the reason their choices disgusted me today was… that they had made the wrong choice to gain more, then tried to justify themselves.
hunks.sol: What disgusted me was that they’d chosen to do wrong to get even more, then found ways to justify it.

hunks.baseline: That was how a group made up of individuals who had remained silent learned to fall silent as one. That was how they became the defenders of Ares, an impregnable fortress.
hunks.sol: When each person stayed silent, the whole group learned to do the same. That was how they had become the defenders of Ares, an impregnable fortress.

hunks.baseline: I drew a deep breath. Mental exhaustion, anger, disgust, and countless other emotions churned in my chest.
hunks.sol: I took a deep breath. Exhaustion, anger, disgust—everything churned together in my chest.

hunks.baseline: “Stop spouting this fucking nonsense and lie down. Suck down your potions and get healed while you think about it. *Today is my second birthday.* Think of it that way.”
hunks.sol: “Quit the fucking nonsense and stay down. Drink your potions, get healed, and think about how today’s your second birthday.”

hunks.baseline: Silence filled every direction. Even the groans that had constantly seeped through the corridor could no longer be heard.
hunks.sol: The corridor fell quiet. Even the groans I’d been hearing all around me stopped.

hunks.baseline: Those still standing and those lying on the ground alike either closed their eyes or firmly shut their mouths.
hunks.sol: Those still standing and those lying on the floor alike closed their eyes or pressed their lips shut.

hunks.baseline: Ignoring their trembling gazes, I started walking. I didn’t leave out one final greeting.
hunks.sol: I ignored their trembling gazes and started walking. I didn’t forget a final goodbye.

hunks.baseline: “Fucking morons.”
hunks.sol: “Morons.”

hunks.baseline: I had no interest in whether they realized something after hearing my words or whether they still possessed the mentality of hunting dogs. My only target was one person.
hunks.sol: Whether my words had gotten through to them or they still thought like hunting dogs, I didn’t care. I had only one target.

hunks.baseline: And to reach that fucking bastard who still had not shown himself… there were plenty of obstacles left to break through.
hunks.sol: And to reach the fucker who still hadn’t shown himself, I had plenty more obstacles to break through.

hunks.baseline: My foot landed on neatly trimmed grass.
hunks.sol: My foot came down on neatly trimmed grass.

hunks.baseline: The world was still in the middle of a bitterly cold winter, but after passing through the corridor, the garden spread out at its center was a lush spring.
hunks.sol: Outside, the world was still gripped by winter. But beyond the corridor, the garden at the center of the building was fresh with spring.

hunks.baseline: I had no idea what floor this was. Hundreds of flowers bloomed in profusion, and a smaller number of enemies waited for me among them.
hunks.sol: I had no idea what floor I was on. Hundreds of flowers bloomed around me, and a smaller number of enemies waited among them.

hunks.baseline: “A lot of you gathered. You fucking bastards.”
hunks.sol: “Quite a turnout, you fuckers.”

hunks.baseline: Instead of an answer to my greeting, an arrow packed with mana flew back at me.
hunks.sol: My greeting was answered by an arrow packed with mana.

hunks.baseline: Judging by how precisely it aimed for my eye, the archer who had fired it was a mean bastard. And considering the amount of mana infused into it, there was no doubt he had fired to kill.
hunks.sol: It was aimed straight at my eye. The archer was a nasty bastard, and with that much mana in the arrow, he was plainly trying to kill me.

hunks.baseline: So in this case, returning what I had received was the right thing to do.
hunks.sol: In that case, returning the favor was only fair. At least, that was how I did things.

hunks.baseline: At least, that was my way.
I caught the arrow in my hand and flung it away in the same motion.
hunks.sol: I caught the arrow and hurled it back in the same motion.

hunks.baseline: The arrowhead flashed as it returned to its owner twice as fast and twice as powerfully as when it had first been fired.
hunks.sol: The arrowhead flashed as it flew toward its owner twice as fast and with twice the force.

hunks.baseline: A white blade trembled with a sharp metallic ring.
hunks.sol: A white sword blade shuddered with a sharp metallic ring.

hunks.baseline: A middle-aged man in his fifties stared at me with deeply sunken eyes. He had deflected the arrow with an enormous greatsword.
hunks.sol: A man in his fifties had deflected the arrow with an enormous greatsword. He stared at me, his gaze steady and deep.

hunks.baseline: His seasoned bearing and aura, which had reached the far edge of Peak, reminded me of a Murim martial artist.
hunks.sol: His seasoned bearing and aura reminded me of a Murim martial artist nearing the far end of Peak.

hunks.baseline: “You’re as hot-tempered as I heard, junior.”
hunks.sol: “You’re as impatient as I heard, junior.”

hunks.baseline: With the polite attitude of a junior, I cracked my knuckles.
hunks.sol: With all the courtesy of a junior, I cracked my knuckles.

hunks.baseline: The hardened joints, caked with dried blood, gave a sound like bones shifting out of place.
hunks.sol: The joints, stiff with dried blood, made a sound like bones shifting out of place.

hunks.baseline: “If you withdraw now, I’ll pass through quietly. Ah, except for the bastard who fired that arrow.”
hunks.sol: “If you step aside now, I’ll pass through quietly. Except for the bastard who fired that arrow.”

hunks.baseline: The instant I finished speaking, one man’s head snapped to the side.
hunks.sol: The archer’s head snapped to one side.

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged man slapped the archer on his right across the face with lightning speed, then looked at me.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man had struck him across the face with lightning speed. Then he looked back at me.

hunks.baseline: “He’s still young and stupid. I ask for your leniency.”
hunks.sol: “He’s young and foolish. I ask you to show him mercy.”

hunks.baseline: “That much should be more than enough to be grateful for. Surviving is what matters.”
hunks.sol: “He should be grateful to get off with that. What matters is that he survives.”

hunks.baseline: He was different from the Ares Guild members I had fought so far. As I stared at him suspiciously, the middle-aged man continued in a calm voice.
hunks.sol: He was different from the Ares Guild members I’d faced so far. As I watched him, the middle-aged man went on calmly.

hunks.baseline: “Your offer is appreciated, but I’m afraid I have to decline. Even if I don’t look it, I’m a Guild executive. I have to cling to your trouser leg and hang on.”
hunks.sol: “I appreciate your offer, but I’m afraid I have to refuse. I may not look it, but I’m a Guild executive. I have to hang on to your trouser leg, if nothing else.”

hunks.baseline: “You won’t see a pretty sight.”
hunks.sol: “That won’t end well for you.”

hunks.baseline: “What can I do? I’m a hunting dog too, in the end. Given the situation, the result is obvious, but I’d appreciate it if you went easy on me.”
hunks.sol: “What can I do? I’m a hunting dog too, in the end. I can guess how this will turn out, but I’d appreciate it if you went easy on me.”

hunks.baseline: I silently studied the middle-aged man. Then I suddenly arrived at a conclusion and opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: I studied him in silence. Then a possibility occurred to me.

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged man’s eyes widened at my words.
That meant I was right.
hunks.sol: His eyes widened. I’d guessed right.

hunks.baseline: And it also meant I had no reason to fight them.
hunks.sol: Which meant I had no reason to fight them.

hunks.baseline: Song Cheonwoo had led his own faction within Ares Guild and openly opposed Go Jun. The middle-aged man in front of me must have shared his convictions.
hunks.sol: Song Cheonwoo had led a faction of his own within Ares Guild and opposed Go Jun. The man in front of me must have sided with him.

hunks.baseline: “I heard it from someone close to him. There’s no need for us to fight, so step aside.”
hunks.sol: “I heard it from someone close to him. We don’t need to fight. Step aside.”

hunks.baseline: “At least for now, I don’t want to waste my strength or time.”
hunks.sol: “At least right now, I don’t want to waste my strength or my time.”

hunks.baseline: The instant I started walking again, the middle-aged man raised his greatsword diagonally.
hunks.sol: As I started forward again, he raised his greatsword at an angle.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: It was an unmistakable stance preparing to attack. His troubled voice reached my ears.
hunks.sol: He was ready to attack. His troubled voice reached me.

hunks.baseline: I answered without stopping.
hunks.sol: I kept walking.

hunks.baseline: “If you don’t want to do this, why are you here? Because you’re just a hunting dog who can do nothing but obey orders?”
hunks.sol: “If you don’t want to, why are you here? Because you’re a hunting dog who can’t do anything but obey orders?”

hunks.baseline: “If you’re afraid of Go Jun, then say you’re afraid. Don’t cover it up by saying you have no choice.”
hunks.sol: “If you’re afraid of Go Jun, say you’re afraid. Don’t dress it up as having no choice.”

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t only the middle-aged man. Everyone looking at me had trembling eyes.
hunks.sol: He wasn’t the only one. Everyone watching me had fear in their eyes.

hunks.baseline: As I continued forward without caring, the more than one hundred people in front of me also began backing away.
hunks.sol: I continued forward. The more than a hundred people ahead of me backed away.

hunks.baseline: An invisible crack appeared across the middle-aged man’s calm expression.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man’s composure began to crack.

hunks.baseline: “The tide has already turned. I heard Director Song returned to the United Kingdom this morning. What do you think that means? I had to find some way to survive. Even if it meant becoming a hunting dog.”
hunks.sol: “The tide has already turned. I heard Director Song returned to the United Kingdom this morning. What do you think that means? I had to find a way to survive. Even if it meant acting like a hunting dog.”

hunks.baseline: Song Cheonwoo had gone to the United Kingdom that morning? It was obviously a lie.
hunks.sol: Song Cheonwoo had gone to the United Kingdom this morning? Obviously a lie.

hunks.baseline: Certain that Go Jun had put forward a stand-in, I let out a quiet snort of laughter.
hunks.sol: Certain that Go Jun had sent a stand-in, I let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: Everyone’s eyes opened wide.
hunks.sol: Every eye widened.

hunks.baseline: I stretched a hand toward the empty air. At the same time, White Flame, summoned from my Inventory, slashed down diagonally.
hunks.sol: I reached into empty air and summoned White Flame from my Inventory. Its blade swept down diagonally.

hunks.baseline: A single line cut across the air.
hunks.sol: A single line cut through the air.

hunks.baseline: Everyone sucked in a breath, but no blood sprayed out, and no one died.
hunks.sol: Everyone caught their breath. But there was no spray of blood, no death.

hunks.baseline: The Force shot along the white spearhead had cut something that was not human.
hunks.sol: The Force that shot from the white spearhead had cut something other than a person.

hunks.baseline: The enormous stone statue standing atop the ornate fountain at the center of the garden broke into pieces and collapsed.
hunks.sol: At the center of the garden stood an ornate fountain. The enormous stone statue planted atop it broke apart and collapsed.

hunks.baseline: The remains of a statue modeled after a man who was already dead crushed the flowers beneath it.
hunks.sol: Fragments of a man already dead crushed the flowers below. Its severed head rolled across the ground until it came to rest at my feet.

hunks.baseline: Its head, severed from the body, rolled and rolled until it reached my feet.
The statue was too lifelike to be called a mere stone figure, and I recognized the face without difficulty.
hunks.sol: The statue was so lifelike I had no trouble recognizing its face.

hunks.baseline: Today, this magnificent palace built by an ambitious warlord who had wanted to possess everything would collapse.
hunks.sol: Today, the magnificent palace built by an ambitious warlord who had wanted everything would fall.

hunks.baseline: Along with his disciple, who had become a monster.
hunks.sol: Along with the disciple who had become a monster.

hunks.baseline: I tossed out a single remark toward the dumbstruck people.
hunks.sol: I tossed a few words at the stunned crowd.

hunks.baseline: “There are two choices. Put down your weapons and clear a path, or watch my back.”
hunks.sol: “You have two choices. Put down your weapons and clear a path, or cover my back.”
